Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add OpenVox WebUI project structure and foundation

- Backend: Rust + Axum with SQLx for database
- Frontend: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
- RBAC system with 5 system roles (Admin, Operator, Viewer, GroupAdmin, Auditor)
- PuppetDB integration service
- Node classification engine with rule-based matching
- Facter generation service
- BDD testing with Cucumber
- RPM and DEB packaging support
- Systemd service unit
- Puppet module for installation and configuration
- Database migrations for users, groups, classification, and RBAC
EOF
)")

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Implement Phase 1.1 and 1.2 - Project setup and core backend

Phase 1.1 - Project Setup:
- Add Rust tooling configs (rustfmt.toml, clippy.toml, rust-toolchain.toml)
- Add Cargo config with build aliases
- Configure ESLint and Prettier for frontend
- Add development environment files (.env.example, .editorconfig)
- Create Makefile with development commands
- Add GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines (disabled by default)
- Add Dependabot configuration
- Add PR and issue templates

Phase 1.2 - Core Backend Architecture:
- Enhanced configuration with env var overrides and validation
- Multiple log formats (pretty, json, compact)
- Comprehensive error handling with AppError enum
- Database connection pooling with SQLite WAL mode
- JWT authentication middleware with access/refresh tokens
- Health check endpoints (simple, detailed, liveness, readiness)
- Request tracing and compression middleware
EOF
)")
